main_body: Large round leaf canopy (rows 0-55) made of several clumps, on a brown tapering trunk with a flared root base (rows 48-78)
top_band: Canopy top: light green clump highlights across rows ~1-12 on the upper lobes, shading to mid and dark green below. These are lit leaf-mass tops, not a flat band. The trunk has no top surface.
evidence: Organic tree. The canopy is built from rounded clumps with lit tops in light green and darker undersides, so it reads as volumes seen from above and in front. Dark green sits under the lobes and the trunk joins in shadow, which acts as an eave shadow. The trunk is a vertical column with a flared base, which is normal for a tree. The canopy volume reads convincingly in 3/4 view, so the organic kind passes. There is no hard front-edge line, which is normal for foliage.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 green steps, from highlight through light, mid and dark to deep, in per-clump leaf dots. The outline is dark green beside leaves and dark brown beside the trunk, with no black sticker line. The trunk carries vertical bark grain in several browns with a darker root flare. The canopy is dense, with many colours per tile, comparable to the Beodeul references. No large flat fills. It is a little more uniform and rounded than the reference's leafy clusters, but it holds up next to them.
